description: This file defines the public API for the SYSCON driver in Zephyr OS, including function prototypes, data structures, and macros for interacting with system control registers.

methods.name: syscon_get_base
methods.description: Get the base address of the syscon region for a device.

methods.name: syscon_read_reg
methods.description: Read a value from a specific syscon register.

methods.name: syscon_write_reg
methods.description: Write a value to a specific syscon register.

methods.name: syscon_get_size
methods.description: Get the size of the syscon register region.
